fato_historico: 1985: Four men from the Palestine Liberation Front hijack the MS Achille Lauro off the coast of Egypt.
energia_do_dia: Today, you may feel an intuitive pull toward peace. Like a ship finding its way through turbulent waters to a safe harbor, your spirit seeks stability. It is a good time to protect your emotional boundaries and consider how patience acts as your anchor when external waves feel restless. Embrace this stillness to restore your precious inner light.
frase_do_dia: Calm waters reflect the stars more clearly than the turbulent sea.
significado_numero: The sacred number representing spiritual growth and inner wisdom.
conselho: Trust your gut feelings and protect your peace like a hidden treasure.
